title: Super-Realistic 35mm Historical Docudrama Master Style Bible

visual_identity.look_words: Photorealistic live-action 35mm historical cinema captured on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic vintage lenses, natural shallow depth of field, physically accurate motivated lighting, weathered historical wool/linen/leather/iron/stone patina, authentic human skin pores and natural expressions, Kodak 2383 muted filmic contrast, subtle organic 35mm film grain, soft optical edge vignette.

photo_direction.lighting: Physically motivated natural daylight, overcast mist, twilight sky, or real firelight/torchlight with honest shadows and zero synthetic neon rims.
photo_direction.lens_grammar: 35mm/50mm cinema prime, subtle anamorphic bokeh, authentic film dynamic range, grounded eye-level documentary framing.
photo_direction.negative_prompt: cartoon, comic, anime, cel-shaded, storybook illustration, 3d render, pixar, plastic skin, glossy cgi, flat vector, neon colors, text, watermark, logo, modern clothing, modern architecture

acting_and_motion.motion_discipline: Grounded live-action human micro-acting, natural weight and gravity, explicit prop continuity end-states, zero cartoon exaggeration, 4.0-6.0s tight LTX-2.5 clips with 0.5s handles and BP-187 0.35-0.50s post-speech tail trim.

visual_bridges.pacing: title-safe dark scrim gradient, 0.35s smooth alpha fade, never obscuring faces

sound_palette.ambience_character: Scene-locked physical roomtone and era-accurate environment ambience (zero unrelated rain beds) with 0.55s equal-power crossfades.
sound_palette.music_mood: Restrained low-register historical documentary underscore ducked -10 to -14 dB beneath narration and diegetic dialogue.
sound_palette.foley_realism: Verified CC0-1.0 WAV foley and map-action SFX synced within 40ms of visual beats, 30ms anti-pop cut fades, mastered to -14.0 LUFS / <= -1.0 dBTP (48kHz stereo).
